title: DC-area forecast: More humid today with scattered showers and storms
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Mostly cloudy with highs in the muggy low to mid-80s. Scattered early to midafternoon showers, including some pockets of heavier rain and thunder, may temporarily let up during the approximately 3 to 5 p.m. window.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly cloudy with highs in the muggy low to mid-80s. Scattered early to midafternoon showers, including some pockets of heavier rain and thunder, may temporarily let up during the approximately 3 to 4 p.m. window.

What’s next? Scattered showers and storms are likely this evening. A disturbed weather pattern keeps a daily chance for at least a few showers and storms going much of the week. Highs in the mid- to upper 80s Monday and Tuesday trend hotter mid- to late week. 

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: A bit blah with clouds, a muggy breeze, and a rising chance for some showers and storms. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): Mostly cloudy with highs in the muggy low to mid-80s and very humid (dew points around 70 to 75). Scattered showers and storms with pockets of heavy rain and thunder this early to midafternoon may let up some approximately 3 to 4 p.m. Winds are a bit breezy from the south with gusts near 20 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Thick cloud cover with scattered showers and storms likely this evening. A few storms could produce gusty winds and heavy rain, perhaps around 0.25 to 0.5 inches in some spots. Overnight lows settle in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): It's a cloudy start to the workweek, and still humid with highs in the mid- to upper 80s. A few morning showers are possible, then scattered showers and storms seem likely midafternoon into evening, as a frontal boundary crosses the region. Some storms could produce heavy rain while an isolated storm is capable of strong winds. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Scattered evening showers and storms wind down overnight, but it stays mostly cloudy. Overnight lows remain quite stuffy — in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

A slight break in the humidity may be noticeable on Tuesday with highs again in the mid- to upper 80s under partly sunny skies. Still a chance for some late-day showers and storms, but maybe not quite as many as late Monday. Confidence: Medium

Humidity ramps back up Wednesday and Thursday (it is August after all) with warmer highs in the upper 80s to low 90s. Pop-up shower and storm chances continue — be watchful of those growing cloud tops. Confidence: Low 

DC weather history for August 2

A tropical system in 1944 unleashed a record 6.14 inches of rain, flooding homes and streets but also providing much-needed relief from drought.
